label: Martinische Bibliothek catalogue item 3323: Raspe gift of Wappenbuch vols. 1–3

sources.citation: Verzeichniß der Martinischen Bibliothek, 1775, item 3323, p.137; UB Tübingen OpenDigi, shelfmark Ke XXIV 71

features.value: Der Durchlauchtigen Welt vollständiges Wappenbuch. Nürnberg. 1—3. Band. gr. 8. 1773. GPappe. (Geschenk von Herrn Raspe)

notes: Near-contemporary acquisition/provenance control. The entry treats vols.1–3 as one Wappenbuch object and literally attributes the gift/source to Raspe. It does not by itself prove where or when the binding was executed.

label: Raspe-mediated distribution of cumulative Wappenbuch vols. 1–3 by 1775

relations.note: 1775 printed catalogue records vols.1–3, dated 1773, as Geschenk von Herrn Raspe.
Three-volume Wappenbuch identity is documented during the active series, not only in later retrospective bibliography.

notes: Use alongside Bernd 1830: Bernd supplies retrospective causal explanation; the Martini catalogue supplies near-contemporary circulation/provenance of the cumulative object. Do not infer frontispiece identity or exact supplied binding from the catalogue alone.
